list.name: session
list.label: Run
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "session", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "can3_raw" and r.source == "usb", start: -365d)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value == "can3-all-live-20261111" then "2026-11-11__17-11-50__shop__no-driver" else r._value}))

options.content: Click a **session name in Saved runs** to open its complete recorded time range. The plots match Live CAN3: same channels, colors, units and thresholds. Drag to zoom into a section; last-value cards follow that selected interval. No automatic refresh. Current factors are applied to historical raw data, including provisional conversions.

panels.title: Battery Volts · 0x001
panels.description: 1293 counts versus approximately 12.9 V on dash. Original raw data is retained in InfluxDB. Sensor note: ; dash note: 12.9

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can3_raw" and r.can_id == "1" and r.source == "usb" and (r.session =~ /^${session:regex}$/ or (r.session == "can3-all-live-20261111" and ${session:doublequote} == "2026-11-11__17-11-50__shop__no-driver")) and r._field == "unsigned_be")
  |> group(columns: ["channel", "session", "device", "_field"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 0.01}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Saved runs · click a session to analyze the complete run

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can3_raw" and r._field == "signed_be" and r.source == "usb")
  |> group(columns: ["session"])
  |> reduce(identity: {start_ms: 0, end_ms: 0, samples: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
    start_ms: if accumulator.start_ms == 0 or int(v: r._time) / 1000000 < accumulator.start_ms then int(v: r._time) / 1000000 else accumulator.start_ms,
    end_ms: if int(v: r._time) / 1000000 > accumulator.end_ms then int(v: r._time) / 1000000 else accumulator.end_ms,
    samples: accumulator.samples + 1
  }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with end_ms: r.end_ms + 1}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["start_ms"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with session: if r.session == "can3-all-live-20261111" then "2026-11-11__17-11-50__shop__no-driver" else r.session}))
  |> keep(columns: ["session", "start_ms", "end_ms", "samples"])
